posts.claim: Elections can be manipulated by using fingerprints of dead voters.
posts.claim_source: Remarks cited in IEBC summons notice, 15 Oct 2026
posts.truth: KIEMS kits require live biometrics and reject deceased records.
proof: Elections Act Sec 8 requires IEBC to expunge deceased voters via civil registry data.
KIEMS kits require a live optical biometric match against registered voter records.
System logs create an immutable audit trail rejecting unverified biometric attempts.
posts.pride: Kenyan voter technology runs on verifiable law.
posts.source: Elections Act 2011 s.8; Supreme Court of Kenya Petition No. E005 of 2022; IEBC Voter Registration Regulations
posts.message: KIEMS kits require live biometrics: dead voters cannot cast ballots under Kenyan election law.
posts.action: Check your voter registration status: SMS your ID number to 70000
beats: Civil registry data purges dead files.
posts.caption:
Politicians are talking about dead voters casting ballots ahead of 2027. The law and the technology say otherwise: KIEMS kits require live biometric verification, and Section 8 of the Elections Act mandates continuous register cleanups.

What it means for you: Unbacked claims create voter apathy before the election even starts.

Check your voter registration status: SMS your ID number to 70000.

scripts.radio:
Habari za jioni, mwananchi. Karibu kwenye 'Kenyans Are Asking' na mimi sauti yako ya kuaminika. Wiki hii, kuna mambo mazito yanayozunguka pesa zetu za kodi.

Kwanza kabisa, je, ulisikia vile KRA imetufunulia? Wachunguzi wamegundua njama chafu ya Shilingi bilioni 4 ya ulaghai wa VAT kupitia stakabadhi za uwongo—maarufu kama *fake invoices*. Hebu fikiria kiasi hicho cha pesa. Bilioni nne nzima zinapotea kutoka kwa mfuko wa umma kuelekea mifukoni mwa watu binafsi. Hii ndiyo pesa inayofaa kujenga barabara zetu, kununua dawa hospitalini, na kulipa walimu wetu mishahara bora.

Lakini swali kuu ambalo kila Mkenya anapaswa kujiuliza leo ni hili: Hawa watu wanapata wapi ujasiri wa kutengeneza stakabadhi za uwongo bila kuogopa? Je, kuna mtandao mkubwa ndani ya taasisi zenyewe unaowasaidia kuficha haya madhambi? Tunahitaji majibu, na tunahitaji uwazi. Huu sio wakati wa kusalia kimya wakati rasilimali za nchi zinatafunwa na wachache.

[Kiswahili Summary]
*Kwa ufupi: KRA imefichua ulaghai wa VAT wa shilingi bilioni 4 kupitia stakabadhi ghushi. Hii inaonyesha jinsi fedha za umma zinavyopulizwa na kuacha huduma za kijamii zikiwa duni. Tunahitaji uwajibikaji kamili kutoka kwa mamlaka husika.*
scripts.voice_note: Aki zangu, mnasikia haya madhambi? KRA imefichua udanganyifu wa Shilingi bilioni nne za VAT zilizoliwa kupitia stakabadhi za uwongo! Bilioni nne nzima! Hizi sio pesa za mchezo—ni zile zile zinazofaa kujenga barabara na kununua dawa hospitalini. Swali langu ni moja tu leo: Hawa wajanja wanapata wapi nguvu ya kuiba hivi bila hofu? Si heri tuwe macho na tuulize maswali mazito? Usiibiwe, simama kidete!
scripts.sms: USIIBIWE: KRA imefichua Sh4B ya ulaghai wa VAT kupitia stakabadhi ghushi. Usikubali biashara yako itumike kwa njia haramu. Daima thibitisha risiti zako.
scripts.reels:
[Visual: Host looking directly into the camera with a serious, grounded expression, holding a fake receipt prop.]

[Audio/VO]: 'Shilingi bilioni nne. Hiyo ndiyo pesa ambayo KRA imegundua imepotea kupitia stakabadhi za uwongo za VAT wiki hii. Bilioni nne! Hizo ni shule, hospitali, na barabara zilizomeza na wajanja wachache. Swali ni moja tu kwa serikali na wafanyabiashara: Hii impunity itaisha lini? Kenyans Are Asking, na hatutanyamaza. Wewe unasema nini?'
